description.narrative: This program aims to grant women from Afghanistan an opportunity to continue their postgraduate study at Universitas Islam Internasional Indonesia (UIII) as a scholarship recipients. This opportunity will target women specifically from Afghanistan, who has obtained an undergraduate degree and unable to continue their postgraduate degree.
